name: Greater Push (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Push, Improved Push, Str 13

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus to the free combat maneuver check granted when you use the push ability.

This ability now works on creatures one size larger or smaller than you. If a creature pushed in this way would be moved into a solid object or creature; the victim and the barrier suffer damage based on your size (Medium 1d6, Large 1d8) plus one and a half times your Strength modifier; if this damage destroys the barrier, the victim’s motion continues.
